scenarios.name: Fear of Missing Out entering discards a card and then draws a card
scenarios.ruling: The discard happens first and the draw second, so the discarded card is in the graveyard and the hand is refilled from the library.

scenarios.name: With delirium the attack trigger gives an additional combat phase
scenarios.ruling: Four card types in the graveyard (creature, instant, sorcery, land) satisfy the intervening-if, so after this combat phase there is another one in which a second creature can attack.

scenarios.name: Without delirium the attack trigger does nothing
scenarios.ruling: Only three card types are in the graveyard, so the intervening-if fails, the ability never triggers, nothing is untapped and there is no extra combat.
